S.FORM: alang Puljetji ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Taybu go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 138 buwan, 456 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 98% kyan ku 447 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 2% kyan ku 9 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 94%, Bunun 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Puljetji hya' ga Ulaljuc. tay 'zil na Puljetji hya' ga Qapedang. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ puljetji ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu tajβu ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na puljetji ħjaʔ ɣa ulalju[ʦ|ʨ] taj ʔzil na puljetji ħjaʔ ɣa qape*aŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
